name: 梯度微纹理分析
description: 检查 smooth regions for natural micro-texture from camera sensors. AI images lack sensor-level noise in 梯度s, producing unnaturally clean smooth areas.
mechanism: 此引擎测量颜色变换的原始加速度。从白色涂墙到纯黑夹克的过渡将光子导数猛烈推入超速（最大梯度）。陷阱明确设置在此：伪造拼接物体的边界总是产生侵略性的、不自然的锋利剃刀线梯度。相反，AI幻觉生成的内部质量保持令人窒息的平坦，完全缺乏由物理模拟光学噪声产生的混沌微观梯度涟漪。当这种自然平衡被残暴破坏时（剃刀般锋利的合成边界锁定死寂平坦的蜡质内部），断头台立即落下。
parameters: Gradient operator: Scharr, Window: 16x16 sliding, Metrics: 梯度 熵, smoothness ratio
accuracy: 中等 - 70-80%, higher for diffusion model outputs
source: Nataraj et al. (2019) Detecting GAN generated Fake Images using Co-occurrence Matrices
useCase: Identifying AI生成的 smooth 梯度s lacking natural micro-texture

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Tanaka, K. et al. (2019). Distinguishing Computer Graphics from Natural Images. Digital Investigation.
Barni, M., et al. (2010). Forensic analysis of digital images: Spatial contrast and inconsistency.

strengths:
• 检测AI特有的过于干净的梯度区域
• 计算成本低
• 对具有大面积平滑区域的图像效果显著
limitations:
• 良好的工作室拍摄图像可能产生误报
• 添加噪声后效果降低
• 取决于图像内容
